gen-megrim-gf-kufam: Hairline strokes that all end at one measured thickness give Megrim its wire-bent, angular look. Kufam answers with sturdy, open curves and big lowercase bodies, a tube-bright counterpart to all that thin geometry.
gen-megrim-gf-lexend: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters from thin wire, each stroke ending at the same measured thickness as the last. Lexend is wide and friendly.
gen-megrim-gf-lexend-deca: Futuristic and angular, Megrim runs thin as wire across the top, while Lexend Deca below it feels plainer and friendlier. And the big lowercase of that sans-serif body gives the sharp heading something soft to lean on.
gen-megrim-gf-liter: Liter is a modern sans-serif with no stroke contrast at all, tall lowercase and wide mouths on its round forms. Under Megrim's angular wire it reads smoothly.
gen-megrim-gf-mada: Mada is a sans-serif with towering lowercase and curves left refusing to close, nothing like the hairline stroke of its partner. Megrim draws every letter with no thick and thin parts, so Mada gives the page its weight beneath that angular heading.
gen-megrim-gf-martel-sans: Futuristic and angular, Megrim builds tubular, wire-like letters with a skyward x-height line, which suits big and short words. Martel Sans keeps the rest.
gen-megrim-gf-matangi: Megrim sets angular, futuristic letters in tubular strokes that all end at the same measured thickness. Matangi's twine-like sans lowercase is hefty and open.
gen-megrim-gf-maven-pro: Modern and angular, Megrim shows off its wire-bent letters at display scale, with a skyward x-height. Maven Pro, a sans-serif, does the quiet daily work.
gen-megrim-gf-michroma: Michroma is a sans-serif that gives each letter a wide berth, with tall-bodied lowercase and stubby ascender tips. And Megrim, with its tubular angular wire, can take the larger sizes while this body stays small.
gen-megrim-gf-miriam-libre: Megrim is angular and futuristic, drawn like bent wire. Miriam Libre brings a sans-serif lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals and open bends in its s, a sturdy, friendly foil to that hairline heading.
